assessments.reasoning: CreateImportBinding initializes an immutable local binding that records the target module and binding name. On a read, the module environment’s GetBindingValue uses that pair to locate the target environment and request the named binding’s current value.

limitations: Indirection does not make the target value immutable. A target environment that is not instantiated or a target binding that is uninitialized can still cause ReferenceError.
